tool.name: ampvis2 boxplot
tool.description: Generates boxplots of the most abundant taxa using ampvis2
tool.command: Rscript --vanilla <<__RSCRIPT__ library(ampvis2) data <- readRDS("$input_dataset$") metadata <- readRDS("$metadata$") boxplot <- amp_boxplot(data, metadata) ggsave(boxplot, filename="$output$") __RSCRIPT__

param.name: input_dataset
param.label: Ampvis2 RDS Dataset
param.help: The ampvis2 RDS dataset obtained from previous tools

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata List
param.help: Metadata list output from ampvis2 tools

tool.help:
# ampvis2 boxplot
Generates boxplots of the most abundant taxa using the ampvis2 package.
## Input
- **Ampvis2 RDS Dataset**: The RDS file generated by previous ampvis2 tools. - **Metadata List**: Metadata list output from ampvis2 tools.
## Output
- **Boxplot**: The generated boxplot in PDF or PNG format.
